tests.scenario: Given the eligible copilot history and job summaries and verified input, choosing run, cost and evidence inspection produces this observable result: Present published duration, usage/cost and verification artifacts only when the producer supplies them.
For run, cost and evidence inspection, exercise the concrete boundary: Missing usage is unknown, never zero, and no billing value is inferred from a model name.
A denied, truncated or expired source for run, cost and evidence inspection shows its exact unavailable/partial reason instead of a zero or success.
Changing the selected repository/account/revision while run, cost and evidence inspection is loading prevents the late result from rendering.
